turns.question: Which customer country cancelled the biggest share of its orders between 17 August and 30 September 2026, and what share?
turns.answer: US customers cancelled the biggest share of their orders from 17 August to 30 September 2026: a cancellation rate of 13.3 % (0.1333) of orders. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And which country cancelled the smallest share?
turns.answer: GB customers cancelled the smallest share of their orders from 17 August to 30 September 2026: a cancellation rate of 6.1 % (0.0606) of orders. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
